_about: Every public-domain Thomas Boston (1677-1732, Ettrick) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is M'Millan's Whole Works (12 vols, 1848-1852, including his Memoirs), Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted, each volume number read off its title page; vol. 9 comes from a Google scan because the main series' copy returned HTTP 500 on 2026-10-02. The Crook in the Lot is held clean from CCEL. No Gutenberg Boston found.
